title: Speaking — School memories
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on school memories.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
What is one thing you enjoyed about school apart from lessons?
Do you ever go back to a place connected with your school days?

part2.topic: Describe a school activity that taught you something lasting.
part2.closing: and explain how you have used that lesson since.

questions: What types of learning tend to remain useful long after school?
How should schools give all students the opportunity to join extracurricular activities?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to school memories?
